title: Houses and renovations, Brisbane: house painting
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Paint the outside of a two storey house
swms.task: Paint the outside walls, eaves and gutters of a two storey house with water-based paint from a mobile scaffold and ladders, after sanding and filling.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the water-based paints and fillers are kept at the work area. Avoid skin contact. Wear gloves and eye protection.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection and scaffolds were considered first for every task, and an elevating work platform where they cannot be fixed.

steps: Work at height on the outside of the structure
